summary: Reviewed w1-a1-canonical-taxonomy (commit 98a3ce6). Implementation fully satisfies the feature description: (1) schema.ts updated with optional itemType field (5-value union: thread|artifact|planner|utility|custom); (2) resolveCanonicalWorkspaceItemType() in workspaceHelpers.ts correctly resolves from itemType, source fields, or legacyType with dual-read migration support; (3) normalizeCanonicalWorkspaceItemType() properly rejects invalid values to 'custom'; (4) workspaceItemTypeForArtifact() and workspaceCategoryForArtifact() in workspaceItemSync.ts map all 16 artifact types; (5) artifact-types.ts defines 9 canonical types with ARTIFACT_TO_CANONICAL_WORKSPACE_TYPE and LEGACY_TYPE_TO_CANONICAL_WORKSPACE_TYPE mappings; (6) canonicalWorkspaceTypeForArtifactType() and canonicalWorkspaceTypeForLegacyType() functions provided; (7) syncWorkspaceItemForArtifact() uses canonicalWorkspaceItemTypeForArtifact() which always returns 'artifact' for storage-level type, correct since all artifacts share that storage type. All 135 tests pass. No blocking issues found.
